findings.title: External refund guarantees remain unverified
findings.evidence: Retries reconcile the matching charge before posting, but a timed-out request could remain active externally after the scheduled action ends. The packet does not establish provider idempotency or immediate canonical visibility.
findings.impact: Local serialization fixes the reported active-worker overlap. Exactly one external financial effect still depends on provider behavior. No duplicate financial effect is demonstrated.
findings.recommendation: Keep external refund validation pending until the dedicated sandbox check and provider refund guarantees are established.

static_inspection: The scheduled job ID and run number are persisted transactionally. Retry rejects pending and in-progress jobs, independent of elapsed time.
Claim and completion guards reject duplicate claims and stale completion.
Added tests explicitly cover both deadline orders, approval and revision preceding a flag, interrupted-run recovery, and a paused provider POST with retry after two minutes.
The browser harness mounts the actual /painel component tree using synthetic authenticated identities and navigation/transport adapters.
No remaining concrete synthetic application defect was established in the focused corrections.

supplied_execution_evidence.suite: 2 Node tests and 72 Vitest tests passed.
supplied_execution_evidence.browser: Two walkthroughs passed with participant reloads, reviewer decisions, reputation checks and authorized downloads.
supplied_execution_evidence.checks: Standalone typecheck and optimized build succeeded.

rationale.identity_checks: All 19 final snapshot hashes match final-hashes.json. Specification and plan hashes match approval.md. Browser harness hash matches browser-result.json.
rationale.prior_review_resolution: The reported local retry overlap is corrected. Transition-order and interruption coverage is materially improved. Browser coverage now includes the actual page tree, with integration boundaries explicitly disclosed. The payment-readiness extract documents the previously unverifiable blocker.

limitations: Only files in the restricted read-only packet were accessed.
Application tests were not executed during this recheck; test results are supplied evidence.
Interrupted-run coverage simulates termination by cancelling the scheduled job; it does not demonstrate an actual worker crash.
Browser evidence excludes browser sign-in, deployed routing, real Convex transport and external refunds.
Hashes establish artifact identity, not that supplied execution logs originated from those exact bytes.
The sandbox refund remains unobserved; this verdict does not establish full provider acceptance.
